왜 이 제품인가

  • 1일 1회(1정) 섭취로 나이아신 17.5mg, 마그네슘 175mg, 비오틴 200μg, 비타민 B1 25mg, 비타민 B12 12μg, 비타민 B2 25mg, 비타민 B6 25mg, 엽산 400μg, 판토텐산 12.5mg

  • 엽산

  • 판토텐산

Health Functional FoodNiacin 17.5mgMagnesium 175mgBiotin 200μgVitamin B1 25mgVitamin B12 12μgVitamin B2 25mgVitamin B6 25mgFolate 400μgPantothenic acid 12.5mgOnce a day

하루 1알 에너지 비타민B MIXNiacin · Magnesium · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Folate · Pantothenic acid

Made by (주)웰레스트 · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 17.5mg of Niacin, 175mg of Magnesium, 200μg of Biotin, 25mg of Vitamin B1, 12μg of Vitamin B12, 25mg of Vitamin B2, 25mg of Vitamin B6, 400μg of Folate, 12.5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 17.5mg Niacin, 175mg Magnesium, 200μg Biotin, 25mg Vitamin B1, 12μg Vitamin B12, 25mg Vitamin B2, 25mg Vitamin B6, 400μg Folate, 12.5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)웰레스트

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Magnesium
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (17.5mg / 900mg), 80~150%
Magnesium labelled (175mg / 900mg), 80~150%
Biotin labelled (200μg / 900mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B1 labelled (25mg / 900mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (12μg / 900mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (25mg / 900mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (25mg / 900mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (400μg / 900mg), 80~150%
Pantothenic acid labelled (12.5mg / 900mg), 80~180%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 주황색의 점박이가 있는 연한 노란 주황색의 장방형 제피정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월까지
Storage 직사광선과 고온다습한 곳을 피하여 실온에 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Magnesium · Biotin · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Folate · Pantothenic acid together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

Made by 주식회사 다움 · Once a day · 2 tablets

This product combines 15mg of Niacin, 157mg of Magnesium, 30μg of Biotin, 1.2mg of Vitamin B1, 2.4μg of Vitamin B12, 1.4mg of Vitamin B2, 1.5mg of Vitamin B6, 400μg of Folate, 5mg of Pantothenic acid as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (2 tablets): 15mg Niacin, 157mg Magnesium, 30μg Biotin, 1.2mg Vitamin B1, 2.4μg Vitamin B12, 1.4mg Vitamin B2, 1.5mg Vitamin B6, 400μg Folate, 5mg Pantothenic acid
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 주식회사 다움

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Magnesium
    • Needed for energy utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal nerve and muscle function
  • Biotin
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
  • Folate
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Pantothenic acid
    • Needed for the metabolism of fat, carbohydrate and protein and for energy production

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day2 tablets per servingWith water
